explanation: This is a `rfl` lemma that unfolds the library's own definitions. Both `fromTensorLimit` (line 379) and `tensorToLimits` (line 312) are defined in `AlgebraicDirectLimits/VaryingScalar.lean`. They set up a direct-limit construction in which the scalar ring also varies, and Mathlib has no such construction. The statement only says how the library's map acts on a representative `⟦⟨i, x⟩⟧`. All of its content comes from the library's definitions, so no Mathlib declaration can state the same result. I only checked with a grep that both definitions belong to the library; I did not search Mathlib.
